title: MineTweaksX
description: The plugin aims to add tweaks that will simplify the game and could be added to the game.
body:
MineTweaksX it's continuation of [MineTweaks](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/minetweaks.96757/). plugin and his update to minecraft 1.21+.

MineTweaks is a plugin that aims to bring vanilla-friendly gameplay tweaks to your server.

Disclaimer: The author of MineTweaksX does not claim to be the author of the MineTweaks plugin; this is merely a fan-made update to the plugin. All the tweaks you see here were made by the author of MineTweaks.

## Features

A comprehensive list of features can be found below. Each feature can be individually enabled or disabled using the provided configuration files.


<details>
<summary>Armor Stands</summary>

<u>Armor Stand Arms:</u>

Armor stands will be automatically given arms when placed.

<u>Armor Stand Offhand:</u>

Holding items in your offhand allows you to place them in the offhand of an armor stand.

![Armorstand offhand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4sTpDt00/images/f7ba0052cb8a840286b8e3fb1912b63d4490c709.png)

<u>Armor Stand Invisibility:</u>

Tossing an invisibility potion at an armor stand will make it invisible.

![Invisible armor stand](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4sTpDt00/images/4e245c269f68f6ba6a4e57835887f177ec5bab9f.png)

<u>Water Removes Armor Stand Invisibility:</u>

Tossing a splash water bottle at an invisible armor stand will make it visible again.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Blocks</summary>

<u>Anvil Cobblestone Compressing:</u>

Allows anvils to convert cobblestone to sand when landing on it.

<u>Beehive Display:</u>

Shows players the amount of honey and bees in a hive when right clicking with an empty hand.

<u>Downwards Ladder Building:</u>

Allows building ladders downwards by clicking on a higher ladder while holding a ladder.

<u>Fast Leaf Decay:</u>

Causes leaves to decay quickly when a tree is chopped down.

<u>Flint And Steel Sponge Drying:</u>

Allows players to dry sponges by clicking them with a flint and steel.

<u>Pumpkin Carving:</u>

Shift clicking a pumpkin with shears will allow you to carve special player head pumpkin designs.

<u>Slimeball Piston Conversion:</u>

Allows players to convert pistons into sticky pistons by right clicking with a slimeball.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Dispensers</summary>

<u>Dispenser Cauldron Emptying:</u>

Allows dispensers to empty cauldrons with empty buckets.

<u>Dispenser Cauldron Filling:</u>

Allows dispensers to fill cauldrons with buckets.

<u>Dispenser Block Placing:</u>

Allows dispensers to place blocks in front of them.

<u>Dispenser Nether Wart Bonemealing:</u>

Allows dispensers to bonemeal nether wart.

<u>Dispenser Sand Bonemealing:</u>

Allows dispensers to bonemeal sand.

<u>Dispenser Small Flower Bonemealing:</u>

Allows dispensers to bonemeal small flowers to duplicate them.

<u>Dispenser Sugar Cane Bonemealing:</u>

Allows dispensers to bonemeal sugar cane.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Farming</summary>

<u>Cactus Bonemealing Tweak:</u>

Allows players to bonemeal cactus.

<u>Nether Wart Bonemealing:</u>

Allows players to bonemeal nether wart.

<u>Right Click Harvesting:</u>

Allows players to harvest fully grown crops by right clicking.

<u>Sand Bonemealing:</u>

Allows players to bonemeal sand for dead bushes.

<u>Small Flower Bonemealing:</u>

Allows players to bonemeal small flowers to duplicate them.

<u>Sugar Cane Bonemealing:</u>

Allows players to bonemeal sugar cane.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Item Frames</summary>

<u>Item Frame Invisibility:</u>

Splash invisibility potions will make item frames invisible.

<u>Water Removes Item Frame Invisibility:</u>

Splash water bottles will return invisible item frames to visible.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Items</summary>

<u>Armor Swap:</u>

Allows players to swap held armor with currently equipped armor.

<u>Infinity Water Bucket:</u>

Allows the creation of infinite water buckets using an infinity enchanted book.

<u>Use Crafting Table in Inventory:</u>

Allows players to use crafting tables from their inventory by pressing F on them.
Also can be locked by permission.

<u>Use Ender Chest in Inventory:</u>

Allows players to use ender chests from their inventory by pressing F on them.
Also can be locked by permission.

<u>Player Head Drops:</u>

Allows players to drop their head when killed by another player.

<u>Sweet Berry Planting:</u>

Stops players from planting sweet berries when trying to eat them, players must sneak to plant them.

<u>Trowel:</u>

A tool that will place a random block from the players hotbar.

<u>Wearable Banners:</u>

Allows players to wear banners on their head.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Miscellaneous</summary>

<u>Blood Effect:</u>

Allows players to see a blood effect when attacking enemies.

<u>Colored Item Names:</u>

Allows players to color item names in an anvil using the & color codes.

![Colored Item Names](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4sTpDt00/images/caaaac46f743601cc9a61f1da7701fde3dfdfef7.png)

<u>Dyeable Name Tags:</u>

Allows players to dye the name of named mobs using any type of dye.

![Dyeable Name Tags](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4sTpDt00/images/f1e149f299bd07df20acc56def6f0c4c774352e5.png)

<u>Location HUD:</u>

Allows players to see their location in the action bar.

<u>Swing Through Grass:</u>

Allows players to attack entities through tall grass and other passable blocks.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Mobs</summary>

<u>Bedrock Wither Health:</u>

Sets the wither's health to 600 (instead of 300) to match bedrock edition.

<u>Chicken Plucking:</u>

Allows players to pluck feathers from a chicken, dealing damage in the process.

<u>Disable Enderman Griefing:</u>

Stops endermen from picking up blocks.

<u>Firework Creepers:</u>

Makes creepers explode into fireworks. Block damage can also be disabled.

![Firework Creepers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/4sTpDt00/images/1e3180d05142db7ceec0b16be148db04c21cac49.png)

<u>Show Horse Stats:</u>

Allows players to see the speed and jump strength of a ridden horse.

<u>No Mob Farmland Trampling:</u>

Stops mobs or/and players from trampling farmland.

<u>Protect Pets:</u>

Prevents you from damaging your own pets.

<u>Poisonous Potato Baby Mobs:</u>

Allows players to prevent baby animals from growing up by feeding them a poisonous potato.

<u>Snowman Head Restoration:</u>

Allows players to restore a snow man's pumpkin by right clicking with a pumpkin.

<u>Shulker Dyeing:</u>

Allows players to dye shulkers the same way you can dye sheep.

<u>Silence Mobs:</u>

Allows players to silence mobs by right-clicking them with a block of wool.

<u>Wither Spawns Wither Skeletons:</u>

Makes the wither spawn 3 wither skeletons when it reaches half health to match bedrock edition.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Recipes</summary>

<u>Cobwebs From String:</u>

Allows crafting cobwebs using 5 string.

<u>Dispensers from Droppers:</u>

Allows crafting dispensers with a dropper, sticks, and string or just with dropper and bow.

<u>More Stairs:</u>

Increases the number of stairs crafted at once.

<u>More Trapdoors:</u>

Increases the number of trapdoors crafted at once.

<u>Red Sand from Dye:</u>

Allows crafting red sand with sand and red dye.

<u>Red Sand from Iron:</u>

Allows crafting red sand with sand and iron nuggets.

<u>Rotten Flesh to Leather:</u>

Allows smelting rotten flesh to get leather.

<u>String From Cobwebs:</u>

Allows crafting cobwebs into 5 string.

<u>Uncompress Quartz:</u>

Allows converting quartz blocks back to quartz.

<u>Unlock All Recipes:</u>

Unlocks all recipes for a player when they join.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Scoreboard</summary>

<u>Scoreboard Health:</u>

Shows player health on the scoreboard.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Wandering Trader</summary>

<u>Announce Spawn:</u>

Announces the location to all players when a wandering trader spawns.

<u>Replace Trades:</u>

Replaces the default wandering trader traders with custom trades.

</details>
